events.verdict: Pippen Jr. (MEM) is late to the spot and initiates body contact with Sexton (UTA) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Williams (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position during Morant's (MEM) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Collins (UTA) re-positions himself in a screening position in Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) path and does not deliver contact.
Bane (MEM) and Markkanen (UTA) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Collier (UTA) do not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Sexton (UTA) establishes himself in a screening position in Clarke's (MEM) path and the two players briefly engage before Sexton releases to move towards the basket.
Morant (MEM) remains in bounds before making the pass into the frontcourt.
